scope: One future ACTION startup observation, no build/install/source/runtime action performed.

capture.clock: Recorded appearance epoch converted once to host monotonic deadline at first external observation; deadline never reset.
capture.end: Fixed deadline or earlier command/setup failure; no extension/retry.
capture.initialScreenshot: Same command/location, now externally polled asynchronously to discover appearance while command is in flight. This is an observation-method difference.
capture.cleanup: Python signal/finally/atexit handlers installed before Popen; direct owned child PID registered immediately; only exact still-unreaped Popen child terminated/killed. No group/service action. stdout/stderr/image partials retained; pipe drain bounded1s. Executor must terminate exact launched app after helper exit and verify; device/DD unchanged.
capture.flags: Previous action environment plus STARTUP_OBSERVATION=1 and fresh run ID. Real orthographic hands, ordinary TrainUNMOUNT, prestart suppression, counters and old sampler policy unchanged.

schema: Release must bind reviewed actual event names, required fields, and any span pairing identities. No context/attempt fields or desired ordering guessed before source schema is final.
validator: Exact environment/new binary/parity/trace/capture intervals and marker schema; missing completed spans right-censored. No Hang/phase/color prerequisite.
limitations: Public command return/timeout and external trace observation are not GPU presentation proof.
Exact direct command child cleanup does not imply unrelated/shared process ownership.
A timed-out initial screenshot may create a partial image; retained as such.
No automatic retry even if appearance or window incomplete.
